obs.title: Observability
obs.lead: Traces, metrics and trace-correlated logs from your generated backend, through OpenTelemetry, with secrets kept out.
obs.offHint: Enable it to include telemetry in the next generated backend.
obs.collectHelp: OpenTelemetry can record request, rule, hook and database spans. Logs stay on standard output and correlate by trace ID.
obs.protectHelp: Request and response bodies, headers, cookies and SQL parameter values are excluded. Built-in redaction covers these key fragments.
obs.stackHelp: The generated stack includes an OpenTelemetry collector, Jaeger and Prometheus. Configure the endpoint and credentials with environment variables.
obs.advice: Suggested share of traces to keep: {{ratio}}%.
obs.savedAdvice: Suggested share at the saved peak traffic: {{ratio}}%.
obs.rpsHelp: The suggestion targets about 200 spans per second at four spans per request.
obs.over: Your setting is higher than the suggested share.
obs.versions: Local images use Collector {{collector}}, Jaeger {{jaeger}} and Prometheus {{prometheus}}. Minimum versions are {{sdk}} for the SDK and {{instrumentation}} for instrumentation.

jobs.title: Jobs and schedules
jobs.lead: Declare background jobs, the queues they use, worker groups and schedules for the generated app.
jobs.offHint: Enable jobs to declare handlers and schedules.
jobs.dangling: Schedules that point at a job that is not declared: {{names}}.
jobs.cron: Use five numeric cron fields: minute, hour, day of month, month and day of week (Sunday is 0).

flows.title: Workflows
flows.lead: Multi-step processes that survive restarts and can undo finished steps when a later step fails.
flows.offHint: Enable workflows to declare a process and its steps.
flows.order: Steps run in list order. Compensation runs in reverse order.
flows.unavailable: Runs are available through the generated app’s workflow API.
flows.jobProblem: Steps that point at undeclared jobs: {{names}}.

workers.title: Workers and queues
workers.lead: See which worker groups run background jobs, where they run and which queues they read.
workers.offHint: Configure worker groups in Jobs and schedules.
workers.topology: The API enqueues work in the database. Worker groups claim jobs from their assigned queues and call the declared handlers.
workers.artifacts: Separate server configuration is generated under deploy/workers/<group>/.
workers.workflowOff: Enable Workflows to generate its worker process.
workers.advisorHelp: Recommendations use the advisor’s default requirements.
workers.environment: Separate server files include compose.yml and .env.example. Configure DATABASE_URL, JOBS_CONCURRENCY, JOBS_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS, JOBS_SCHEDULER_ENABLED, DB_POOL_SIZE and WORKER_REPLICAS.
workers.pool: Size each replica’s database pool for its concurrency plus two connections. Keep all pools within the database’s max_connections limit.
workers.deadJobs: The generated project provides python -m app.jobs.admin list-dead and python -m app.jobs.admin requeue [JOB_ID].

trace.title: Traces
trace.lead: See where the time went in one request. Paste or upload a trace to inspect it locally.
trace.format: Use a document with trace_id and spans. Supports up to 2 MB and 5,000 spans.
trace.emptyHelp: Paste a trace or choose a JSON file to get started.
trace.error: This trace could not be shown.
trace.fileError: Could not read that file. Try another JSON file.
trace.size: This trace is larger than 2 MB. Trim it and try again.
trace.settingsHelp: APP_OTEL_ENABLED switches instrumentation, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT points to your collector and OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG sets the sample share.

search.title: Search
search.lead: Search the records you imported. Results only include what the role you pick is allowed to see.
search.empty: Add an entity first, then import records to search.
search.ownHelp: Without a selected role, results use permissions that apply without a generated-app role.
search.noHits: Try another query or review the selected role.
search.max: Search returns up to 100 results. Narrow the query to see a different set.
search.indexHelp: Imported records are read from the database at query time. Reindex reports the current coverage.
search.pipelineHelp: Search applies list permissions and row scope, then matches and ranks records using readable text fields.

metrics.title: Metrics & reports
metrics.lead: Define numbers from imported records. Reports collect metrics and run on a schedule.
metrics.metricCount: {{count}} of 100 metrics · Up to 50,000 records and 100 groups per metric
metrics.noMetricsHelp: Create a metric to count or measure imported records.
metrics.needMetric: Create a metric first. A report collects metrics.
metrics.noReportsHelp: Create a report to gather metrics on a schedule.
metrics.name: Name
metrics.noRunsHelp: Run the report now or wait for its next scheduled run.
metrics.metricInUse: This metric is still used by a report, so it was kept. {{message}}
metrics.tooLarge: This metric covers too many records to compute. Add a filter to narrow it. {{message}}
metrics.quota: The plan limit for report runs was reached.
metrics.quotaUsage: The plan allows {{limit}} this period and {{used}} are used.

preset.monthly: First day of the month at 08:00

metrics.filterRemoveHelp: This removes the filter from the draft.
metrics.listRefresh: Saved. The list could not refresh.

validation.service: Use lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, starting with a letter (up to 63 characters).
validation.ratio: Enter a sample ratio from 0 to 1.
validation.rps: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1,000,000.
validation.path: A path starts with a slash and uses letters, digits or /_.-.
validation.key: Use lowercase letters, digits, underscores, hyphens or periods (2 to 40 characters).
validation.cron: Enter a valid five-field cron expression. Use numeric ranges, lists and steps.
validation.zone: Enter an IANA time zone, such as UTC or Asia/Kolkata.
validation.reportName: Enter a report name of 1 to 120 characters.
validation.metricName: Enter a metric name of 1 to 120 characters.
validation.metricUnit: Use at most 30 characters for the unit.
validation.backend: Choose Postgres, the supported queue backend.
validation.handler: Enter a plain Python function name from app/hooks/jobs.py.
validation.stepJob: Choose a declared job for this step.
validation.hookJob: Only a job step can name a job.
validation.duplicate: This name is already used in the list.
validation.pickQueue: Choose a queue used by a declared job.
validation.filterValue: Enter a value for every filter item.
validation.filterDate: Enter a date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
validation.filterDateTime: Enter an ISO date and time.
validation.filterLimit: Use up to 100 values in an inclusion filter.
validation.filterField: Choose a readable scalar field from this entity.
validation.metricGroup: Choose a group field from this entity.
